source_row.rationale: Pulmonary fibrosis involves progressive scarring and stiffening of lung tissue, impairing normal lung expansion and gas exchange, causing the characteristic progressive dyspnea and persistent dry cough, with symptoms typically worsening over time as fibrosis progresses.
